The Battle of Endor'' |author=[[Ella Patrick]]{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/735635/star-wars-return-of-the-jedi-the-battle-of-endor-by-ella-patrick|text=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi: The Battle of Endor}} |cover artist= |illustrator=*[[TomatoFarm]] *[[PowerStation Studios]] |editor= |publisher=[[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] |early release= |release date=[[March 7]], [[2023]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=32 |isbn=9781368093477 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[4 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which this book adapts, in [[4 ABY]]. |series=''[[World of Reading]]'' |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Return of the Jedi: The Battle of Endor''''' is a [[World of Reading]] Level 2 young readers book by [[Ella Patrick]] that adapts events from {{Film|VI}}. It was published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[March 7]], [[2023]]. ==Publisher's summary== '''''Relive the excitement of''''' ''''''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi''''''''!''''' ''On the Forest Moon of Endor, rebel heroes Luke Skywalker, Princess Leia and Han Solo meet the Ewoks, furry beings who are as fierce as they are cuddly! The Ewoks help Han and Leia in their mission to blow up the shield bunker that protects the second Death Star, while Luke faces Darth Vader and the Emperor in a final battle!'' ''Parents and kids alike will love this tribute to one of the most beloved films of all time.'' ==Plot summary== {{Plot|adaptation}} ==Development== ''Return of the Jedi: The Battle of Endor'' was published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[March 7]], [[2023]]. The book reuses some art from the short story "[[A Fight for the Galaxy|A Battle for the Galaxy]]," published in [[5-Minute Star Wars Stories (second edition)|''5-Minute Star Wars Stories'']].{{StoryCite|story=A Fight for the Galaxy|book=5-Minute Star Wars Stories (second edition)}} However the text and other images are original to the book. ==Media== ===Editions=== *{{ISBN|9781368093477}};
